explanations: The fallbacks work, but render() caches every page it builds for 60 seconds, degraded ones included. A page built while reviews was failing (or ETA timed out) holds the fallback values, and it keeps being served for a full minute after the dependency recovers. The no-store header shows the page was never meant to be reused. A fallback is a stand-in for this one response, not data worth keeping. The fix caches a page only when nothing was degraded, so the next request tries the optional services again.
